name: Georgia
flagName: Flag of the State of Georgia
summary: Red, white and red horizontal bands with a blue canton containing the state arms in a ring of thirteen stars and the motto 'In God We Trust'. It closely follows the first national flag of the Confederacy, the 'Stars and Bars'.
origin: From 1956 Georgia's flag included the Confederate battle flag, a change widely seen as a protest against desegregation. In 2001 it was replaced by a compromise design that was unpopular.
The current flag, adopted on 8 May 2003, removed the battle flag but is based on the Stars and Bars. A 2004 referendum confirmed it.

symbols.name: Thirteen stars
symbols.description: A ring of white stars around the arms.
symbols.meaning: Georgia as one of the original thirteen states.

symbols.name: Arch and three pillars
symbols.description: The state arms: an arch supported by three pillars, with a soldier.
symbols.meaning: The three branches of government; the motto 'Wisdom, Justice, Moderation'.

facts: The 2001 flag was ranked the worst-designed flag in North America in a 2001 NAVA survey.
The country of Georgia, in the Caucasus, has a completely different flag.
The Stars and Bars was the Confederacy's first national flag (1861–1863).
clues: Red-white-red bands with a blue canton holding a ring of thirteen stars around an arch.
